properties.verseOrder: v1 c1 v2 b1 b2 e1

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Deliverer, You brought us out of the miry clay
Set our feet upon the rock and You made us say
Holy is the Lord

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You are worthy of affection
You’re the radiance of all of His glory
Let adoration fill this place
You hold everything together
By the word of Your immovable power
We sing a song of praise

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
We are the broken down and we are the beaten up
But what can stop us from a song of unending love
Holy is the Lord

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Worthy are You, Lord
Worthy are You, Lord
Worthy are You, Lord
Of all praise

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
All glory to You, Lord
All glory to You, Lord
All glory to You, Lord
Forevermore

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Holy are You, Lord
Holy are You, Lord
Holy are You, Lord

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We would declare Your thoughts about us one by one
They’d be too many to count, so we simply come
And sing of Your great love
So we sing, we lift our hands and sing

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
You are the treasure, the hope, the bright and morning star
You are the lover of our soul and You’ve won our hearts
We sing of Your great love
So we sing, we lift our hands and sing
